Journal

Notes on how Patchland is being made: design choices, problems we hit, and what we learn from playtests.

2026-11-14

Same Rules, Different Boards

With the same rules, the starting board could decide the whole round. So we stopped tying difficulty and targets to a single number.

2026-11-13

Territory on Paper Scraps

Patchland began with the idea of paper scraps. After many prototypes, three verbs remained: trace, place and spread.
